A field guide to an inhabited world · volume VIII · the sea family

Merfolk

Six sea monster girls with tails instead of legs: orca, dolphin, koi, shark, seal and axolotl. Half the world is water, and they rule it. On land they are slow and need to stay wet, so they live where the two meet, and they bring the sea's treasures to those who earn it.

The central similarity

Half the world is water.

Merfolk are fast, graceful and strong in the water and nearly helpless on land. They come ashore only to rest on rocks and beaches near the water, so every meeting with one happens at the edge of the sea, a river or a lake.

  • Water-boundFast swimmers; on land they crawl slowly and dry out (like the anurans, but quicker).
  • Treasure tradeThey love shiny things from the land, and pay back in sea treasure.
  • GuidesA bonded merfolk leads your boat to treasure, like a dolphin.
  • BreathSwimming with a bonded one, you can breathe underwater.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a merfolk builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Fish (any), kelp for the koi and axolotl
  • Shiny things from land: gold, copper, amethyst, emeralds (she trades back a sea treasure)
  • Music near the water (a jukebox on the shore)
  • Petting while she rests on a rock

What costs trust

  • Fishing her favourite spot empty
  • Hitting her
  • Dragging her (on a lead) away from water

Devoted (60+)

Conduit Power while you swim near her, and she brings you prismarine, nautilus shells, pearls (an occasional heart of the sea).

Mating & young

FormLive calf/pup (orca, dolphin, shark, seal) or roe on plants (koi, axolotl). YoungCalf, pup, fry or larva, grown in 5 days. WhereIn water; seal pups on a beach or ice. Young use the adult model at 40% scale.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may join you when you sleep in a bed within 8 blocks of water (she lies along the edge of it, tail trailing). By morning she is expecting.
2a. Live youngThe orca, the shark and the seal give birth to one calf or pup (sharks two or three). Seal pups are born on a beach or on ice and stay ashore for their first day.
2b. RoeThe koi and the axolotl lay roe: clusters of eggs on kelp, seagrass or (axolotl) moss underwater. They hatch into fry and larvae.
3. GrownYoung stay with their mother and grow up in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

Water-boundIn water: fast swimmers who never drown. On land: they crawl at a third of normal speed and dry out in about two minutes (the seal and axolotl can stay longer). Rain counts as water.
Basking rocksThey rest on rocks, beaches and ice right next to water, and dive in when anything comes near, unless they trust it.
SongMerfolk sing at dusk from rocks. Bonded swimmers near a singing merfolk get Dolphin's Grace.
GuidesIn a boat or swimming, a bonded merfolk swims ahead towards the nearest buried treasure, shipwreck or ocean ruin, like a vanilla dolphin.
BreathSwimming within 8 blocks of a bonded merfolk you have Water Breathing (Conduit Power at full devotion).
DrownedMerfolk hate drowned and attack them on sight; guardians leave them alone.
True to their kindEach behaves like the animal she comes from. Sharks attack anything that swims, players included, until fed fish or meat. Orcas and dolphins tease: they nudge swimmers and boats, bump squid and fish up out of the water and laugh, never hurting anyone.
SeashellsNow and then a mermaid sifts the sand or gravel of the sea floor and finds a pair of seashells, which she wears over her chest from then on (the shell bra of mermaid stories).

Species profiles

Cold & deep oceanClever · pod

Orca (about 2.3 blocks)

TemperamentClever, playful, fiercely protective

Ecology & behaviourLives in pods led by the eldest female. Hunts together, breaches for fun, and knocks prey off ice floes with a wave.

Signature: Pod, teasing & protectorOrcas play with everything: they nudge swimmers, bump squid and fish up out of the water and laugh about it. A bonded orca and her pod defend you from drowned and guardians.

Player interactionSwim with the pod, and never hurt one of them.

Colour variants

Resident (default) · Black and white, a grey saddleTransient · Black and white with a darker, sharper saddleAntarctic B · Grey and cream, a dark capeWhite · Snow white (rare)Type D · A tiny eyepatch and a rounder head

Spawns incold_ocean, deep_cold_ocean, ocean, deep_ocean, frozen_ocean

DangerModerate: a pod defends itself well.

Rivers, lakes & pondsLucky · graceful

Koi (about 1.8 blocks)

TemperamentSerene, graceful, a little vain

Ecology & behaviourLives in calm fresh water and in ponds people build. Koi bring good fortune, and legend says a koi who climbs a waterfall becomes a dragon.

Signature: Good fortune & waterfall climbA bonded koi in a pond within 32 blocks of you gives Luck (better fishing and loot). She swims up water columns. Ten days at full devotion turns her into a dragon koi (a golden glow mask and longer fins).

Player interactionBuild her a pond. Feed her bread or kelp at the edge.

Spawns inriver, swamp, cherry_grove, mangrove_swamp

DangerNone.

Warm & lukewarm oceanFierce · loyal

Shark (about 2.2 blocks)

TemperamentBlunt, fierce, loyal once won

Ecology & behaviourSmells blood from far away and comes to investigate. She is not cruel, only hungry, and she likes people who feed her.

Signature: Attacks anythingA wild shark attacks anything that swims near her: fish, squid, drowned, swimmers. Fed fish or meat once, she leaves you alone; more food and she warms up to you. Even a bonded shark hunts every fish and monster in the water.

Player interactionThrow her fish or meat (from a boat) until she stops seeing you as prey.

DangerHigh until fed.

Cold ocean, beaches & icePlayful · lazy

Seal (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentPlayful, lazy, endlessly curious

Ecology & behaviourThe selkie of the family: as happy on a beach as in the water. Lounges on sand and ice in groups, barks, follows boats and catches fish for fun.

Signature: Beach lounger & fisherShe moves on land at half speed (the best of the family) and never dries out on a beach. A bonded seal catches fish and brings them to you.

Player interactionThrow her a fish (or a snowball: she balances it on her nose).

Lush cavesSweet · resilient

Axolotl (about 1.5 blocks)

TemperamentSweet, smiley, unflappable

Ecology & behaviourLives in the underground lakes of lush caves. Feathery gill fronds, a permanent smile, and a body that heals almost anything. Plays dead when hurt.

Signature: Regeneration & playing deadHurt, she plays dead and heals fast. After she fights beside you, you get Regeneration (like a vanilla axolotl). She can live on land for a long time if it is damp.

Player interactionBring tropical fish in a bucket. Help her fight drowned and she will help you.

Dolphin (about 2.0 blocks)

TemperamentPlayful, quick, a terrible tease

Ecology & behaviourLives in big chattering pods. Rides bow waves, leaps for the fun of it and teases anything that swims.

Signature: Teasing & leapingShe nudges swimmers and boats, steals a playful bump at squid and fish, then laughs and darts away. A bonded dolphin gives you Dolphin's Grace when she swims beside you.

Player interactionSwim with her, race her, toss her a fish.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Fast swimming, slow crawling on land, drying out
  • Song at dusk (Dolphin's Grace)
  • Water Breathing / Conduit Power for her swimmer
  • Guiding to treasure
  • Hunting drowned (orca also guardians)
  • Treasure trade for shiny things
  • Koi Luck and dragon koi true form
  • Seal at home on beaches
  • Axolotl plays dead and grants Regeneration after kills
  • Roe for koi and axolotl, live young for the others
  • Sword koi: a drowned she defeats always drops what it held (a trident, a nautilus shell, a fishing rod)
  • Reeffin: underwater she grows coral, coral fans and sea pickles on the sand around her
  • Rust otter: befriended, every minute she scrapes a stage of green off the most weathered copper block near her friend; raw copper presents
  • Platypus: in the water she makes every monster within 16 blocks of her friend glow; strangers who hit her are poisoned by her spur
  • Mantarrow: a friend climbs on with an empty hand and rides her across the water, faster than a boat, breathing under it; she leaps from the waves
  • Axolume: lights the water of the lush caves around her; her friend regenerates beside her; axolotls are her kin
  • Siren: her song draws strangers within 24 blocks toward her; friends swimming within 16 get Conduit Power
  • Ahuizotl: steals the catch off your fishing line unless you hold a lantern (which keeps her away); befriended, she fishes for you
  • Dolphin (sixth species): teasing, Dolphin's Grace
  • Sharks attack anything in the water (swimmers until fed)
  • Orcas and dolphins tease swimmers, boats and sea life
  • Seashells found on sandy bottoms, worn as a shell top

Not yet

  • The seal balancing a snowball

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The seal is the family's selkie: she is the only one at home on land.
  • The dolphin joined in 2026-10-20 so the orcas have a teasing partner.
  • The axolotl's colours match the five vanilla axolotl colours, including the rare blue.
  • No hammerhead: its head would need its own model; the five sharks share one.

Open questions

  • Should merfolk be carried in a water bucket while young?
  • Should the dragon koi be able to fly (a slow levitation)?
